gold_answer: Yes. On this date section 17(5)(a) blocks credit on "motor vehicles and other conveyances" except when they are used for making the taxable supplies of (A) further supply of such vehicles or conveyances, (B) transportation of passengers, or (C) imparting training on driving, flying, navigating such vehicles or conveyances, or (ii) for transportation of goods.
